claim: 1 in 5 million in UK have abnormal PrP positivity.

results.claim: 1 in 5 million in UK have abnormal PrP positivity.
results.explanation: Studies show the prevalence of abnormal PrP positivity in the UK is about 1 in 2,000 people, not 1 in 5 million, based on appendix sample surveys detecting abnormal PrP in 16 out of 32,441 samples (about 493 per million) .

sources.title: Study: In UK, 1 in 2000 may carry vCJD protein - CIDRAP
One in 2000 UK people might carry vCJD proteins

results.rewrite: 1 in 2,000 people in the UK have abnormal PrP positivity.
